description: Phase 5 CLI budgets (median ms). Raised only with evidence; never lowered to pass. B8 schema-scale targets from schema-scaling-plan §10.

B8-start-overhead-1k.note: Host start median minus empty at 1,000 synth caps; plan ≤ ~100 ms overhead at 5k.

B8-start-overhead-5k.note: Plan target ≤ ~100 ms; Windows 2026-11-16 measured median 159 ms for 250 light manifests (see bench/baseline). Budget set to 200 ms with evidence — do not treat as a silent loosen of the design target.

B8-editor-write-warm-1k.note: Warm editor rewrite with unchanged stamp; should be ~0.

B8-execute-echo-warm-all-plugins.note: Warm echo with all real MVP plugins; floor for Group E (F6). Same order as B3-warm.
